name: point_screen
notes: LOOKS LIKE: instead of turning to the screen, the arm rears up and reaches out toward it — joint3 to 48, forearm extended to -42, wrist rolled 20 deg to line up — and HOLDS for 2 seconds while the numbers are read. The pointing is the extension, not a yaw. Peak 13.7 deg/s. JOINT1 IS ZERO IN EVERY WAYPOINT. Operator instruction at the arm: there are clamps on the sides of the base, so the base does not turn — the collision model cannot see those clamps, so the person standing there is the authority. hw_backend refuses any stream moving joint1 more than 2 deg. All expressiveness is joint2-joint6 plus the jaws. Positions are OFFSETS from whatever pose the arm is resting in. Full-range revision, authorized 2026-08-30 ('i want you to fully use the arm not just slightly move it'); budgets are measured with arm/measure_range.py and every stream is MuJoCo self-collision-verified before a frame is sent.

waypoints.label: rear up and reach toward the screen
